verified_against: Modrinth project OvlwmUdC (kibe) - full version listing, 38 versions, no jar downloaded
notes: NO QUESTABLE CONTENT. Empty chain is deliberate: THERE IS NO FORGE BUILD OF THIS MOD, FOR 1.20.1 OR FOR ANY OTHER VERSION. Kibe is Modrinth project OvlwmUdC, slug kibe. I enumerated all 38 published versions through the API and filtered them by loader. The project's declared loaders are ['fabric', 'neoforge'] - forge is absent - and a scan of every version confirms it: not one of the 38 lists 'forge' in its loaders array. The two builds that target 1.20.1 are kibe-1.10-BETA+1.20.jar and kibe-1.10.1-BETA+1.20.jar, and BOTH are Fabric-only. NeoForge support does not appear until the 1.21.1 line (2.1-BETA, 2.2, 2.3, 2.3.1), which is the wrong Minecraft version. So on a 1.20.1 FORGE pack, kibe cannot be installed at all, and every kibe: id is a dead task. THE CONSENSUS DATA IS REAL BUT COMES FROM FABRIC PACKS. moddb.json lists 13 kibe ids from up to 6 packs - cobblestone_generator_mk1 through mk5, basalt_generator_mk1 through mk5, trash_can, pocket_trash_can and measuring_tape. That is a genuine and very clean tier ladder (two five-step generator lines plus three utilities) and it would make a good chain, which is exactly why it is worth stating plainly that it cannot be used here: those six packs are Fabric packs. The pack-count is high (6 packs for the generators) precisely because Kibe is a popular Fabric utility mod, and a naive read of moddb ranking would put it high on a build list for a Forge pack where it can never load. NO JAR WAS DOWNLOADED AND NO IDS WERE VERIFIED, because there is no artifact for this loader to verify against. Nothing in this file is guessed from the moddb ids - the 13 above are quoted as moddb's contents, not asserted as verified registry names. IF THE TARGET PACK IS FABRIC OR NEOFORGE, this file should be regenerated against the appropriate jar: kibe-1.10.1-BETA+1.20.jar for Fabric 1.20.1, or kibe-2.3.1-neoforge-1.21.1.jar for NeoForge 1.21.1. DO NOT substitute a similarly-named project. Searching for 'kibe' on Modrinth returns only this one project; the slug kibe-utilities is a 404 and does not exist.
